why: This search is open: no major reviewer or authority shows up in the results. Every result is a niche spec site or an affiliate roundup. Most of them answer a nearby question instead: general under-$1k rankings, RV pages with no budget limit, an under-$2000 roundup, or RV batteries rather than power stations. VoltVanguard comes closest, with an RV table that has prices, but it does no testing anyone can check. A focused page on RV boondocking under $1,000 would stand out: current prices, fridge and solar runtime math, and a direct pick.
